import unittest
from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from datetime import date

PUPIL = Student("s1", "Lovelace", "Ada", "A")


def _mark(day, status="absent", pupil="s1"):
    return Mark(pupil, date(2026, 3, day), status)


class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_sorted_absences(self):
        marks = [_mark(5), _mark(4, "present"), _mark(2)]
        text = absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)
        self.assertIn("Ada Lovelace", text)
        self.assertIn("2 day(s)", text)
        self.assertIn("2026-03-02, 2026-03-05", text)

    def test_other_student(self):
        marks = [_mark(2), _mark(3, pupil="s2")]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)

    def test_no_absences(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(PUPIL, [_mark(2, "late")])
